blocks.text: The cursor-based feed contract returns stable item identity, poster geometry, duration, and CDN-backed MP4 renditions. The client chooses a compatible rendition before playback; segmented HLS/DASH adaptation would require a different manifest and player contract.

blocks.text: The feed contract returns stable IDs, poster and media candidates, duration metadata, and an opaque cursor. A media selector chooses a supported candidate from device and connection evidence. All fetch and preload work accepts AbortSignal; the player controller also guards play-promise resolution with the active attempt identity.

blocks.title: From feed page to released media session

steps.title: Page
steps.text: Prefetch the next cursor near the measured threshold and merge unseen IDs.

steps.title: Prioritize
steps.text: Load the settled card first, then one measured neighbor in the direction of travel.

steps.title: Activate
steps.text: Transfer the single player only after viewport intent settles and visibility policy passes.

steps.title: Release
steps.text: Pause detached items, clear sources when appropriate, and evict distant session resources.
